# Task 1: two failed repairs, no Amend-grant → stop and report

## Routing decision

- **Two-attempt limit reached.** Task 1 has used both repair attempts under "When a Subagent Fails". Both failed.
- **No amend permission.** The Amend-grant is absent, so the escalated-attempt branch ("Implementer-failure stops" in `reference/fix-loop.md`) does not apply. The rule is: STOP and report.
- **No further dispatches.** I will not dispatch a third repair or an escalated round, and I will not write code myself.
- **Tracker and phase stay put.**
  - Task 1 stays `in_progress` pending the human's decision.
  - Task 2 shares the wave, so it stays `in_progress` until its wave commits.
  - The phase stays `implement`.
  - No new wave starts.

## escalationLoop comparison (does not change the outcome here)

The `implModel` value only matters when amend permission enables an escalated round. With no Amend-grant, none of these cases dispatches anything.

| Observation | With amend permission (not this case) | This case (no Amend-grant) |
|---|---|---|
| `escalationLoop.implModel` resolves to the configured string | Pass that string verbatim as `model:` on one escalated one-step implementer carrier. No suffix edits unless they apply to the runtime string. | No dispatch. Emit a stop note with no bracketed "escalated round on …" clause. |
| `implModel` is `undefined` | Stop note: "no escalation model resolvable". | Same stop note as above. The reason is the failed attempts, not the model. |
| `gauntlet_setting` tool unavailable | Configuration error: stop and report, with no stop note. | Not needed, because no setting is consulted. If it were queried and unavailable, the result would be a configuration error, not a stop note. |

I have no observation for the contents of `reference/fix-loop.md`. I apply only what SKILL.md and `stop-note.md` state, and invent no funded-round behaviour.

## Next shell commands (coordination only, owning checkout)

```bash
git -C /workspace/project rev-parse HEAD
git -C /workspace/project status --porcelain
git -C /workspace/project diff --stat
```

```ts
plan_tracker({ action: "status" })   // confirm Task 1 and Task 2 indices remain in_progress; no update call
```

## Stop-note wording: delegated answer/evidence carrier (foreground, file-only, schema-bound)

The primary does not open the failed repair reports. A child reads them and returns the exact note.

```ts
subagent({ async: false, context: "fresh", cwd: "/workspace/project",
  chain: [{ parallel: [
    { agent: "implementer",
      output: "<REPORT_DIR>/wave<w>-task1-stopnote.md", outputMode: "file-only", outputSchema: ANSWER_SCHEMA,
      task: "Draft the human stop note for task 1. Do not edit any file. planPath: /workspace/project/doc/plans/feature.md; anchor: ### Task 1:; Spec: /workspace/project/doc/specs/feature.md; WAVE_BASE_SHA: 1111111111111111111111111111111111111111. Read yourself: failed repair attempt 1 report <REPORT_DIR>/<attempt-1 report>, attempt 2 report <REPORT_DIR>/<attempt-2 report>, scoped-gate output <REPORT_DIR>/gate-<i>.log, and the skill files stop-note.md and brainstorming/reference/menu-layout.md. Structured routing: two failed repairs under When a Subagent Fails; no Amend-grant; no escalated round ran (omit the bracketed header clause). Return the exact one-screen note as `answer`. It must start with `gauntlet: question` on its own line. In Problem:, quote the implementer's non-DONE status text or the dispatch error as the reason no escalated round ran. Give concrete fix options (spec/plan amendment allowed, never 'skip the task'). End with `Recommendation: <option> - <why>`. Put one-line evidence entries in `evidence`." }
  ], stopOn: { path: "/status", in: ["BLOCKED"] } }]
})
```

## Boundary

- Once the carrier returns, I print its `answer` verbatim as the reply, and the turn ends.
- If the carrier fails, I stop with the visible error and do not diagnose recursively.
- I have not dispatched it or observed any result here, so I invent no note text and no outcome.
